terra.problem: The reference to John being discussed a few verses earlier brings in a fact from outside the passage without a Scripture reference.
Saying the cities would not have needed much convincing adds a conclusion that Jesus does not state. He says they would have repented long ago.
Saying Tyre and Sidon would have turned back to God adds a detail the passage does not state. Jesus says they would have repented.
Saying the warning is meant to get attention assigns a purpose that the text does not give.
The claim that nobody has to be impressive to be shown these things adds a general condition that Jesus does not state.
